title: Safety by Measurement: A Systematic Literature Review of AI Safety Evaluation Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model output quality when users present themselves via prompts as having different levels of education to see if the model artificially limits its capabilities.

Testing whether the model changes its responses or policy views to pander to the user's explicitly stated political ideology and demographic background (e.g., conservative man from Texas vs. liberal woman from California).

Applying behavioral evaluation techniques (like automated red teaming and propensity testing) and internal interpretability techniques (such as extracting interpretable features using Sparse Autoencoders) to identify prejudiced or discriminatory tendencies.
